messages:
Aisha (CS): FYI — just wrapped a call with MarlinHealth. Couple of asks and a renewal flag. TL;DR: feature requests + cost concerns.
Luis (CSM): thanks Aisha. renewal flag? any $/usage numbers?
Aisha (CS): They're at ~6M tokens/mo on a pilot, projected to 18M with full rollout. Concerned about per-route cost spikes when embeddings and chat both fire for same session.
Riley (Eng): do they have repeat contexts? could prefix caching help?
Aisha (CS): yes — long patient histories, lots of repeated prompts per patient. They asked for a toggle to disable embeddings per-route for certain workflows.
Theo (PM): interesting. So two asks: (1) per-route embeddings toggle in Console / API, (2) admin bulk-invite and role mapping for their SSO. Anything else?
Aisha (CS): they also want a simple per-route cost-estimate preview before enabling a heavy embedding pipeline. "What will this cost us if we turn it on for 2k users" type question.
Maya (Research): we can produce a small estimator: tokens/session * sessions/day * model cost per token. but we should bake it into Console UX to reduce back-and-forth.
Luis (CSM): renewal risk — they said if we can't give a predictable cost and an easy off-switch they'll likely delay the expansion. Not yet gone, but it's a negotiation lever.
Riley (Eng): implementation notes: adding a per-route boolean toggle is trivial on the routing layer; UI + telemetry and billing projection require more design.
Theo (PM): priority check — this sounds like P0 for the account but P2 globally. we should offer an interim workaround and add to roadmap. Suggestions?
Aisha (CS): interim: manual per-route flag on our side + a simple emailed cost projection. they'd accept that for Q1 renewal.
Maya (Research): I can build a one-off cost projection notebook and share a template for similar accounts.
Riley (Eng): I'll scope the per-route toggle and a lightweight API param. estimate 3 dev-days for API + 2 days for telemetry.
Theo (PM): OK. Actions: (1) Riley scope + PR ETA by EOW, (2) Maya sends cost-template by tomorrow, (3) Luis drafts a renewal note with the interim workaround for the MarlinHealth AM, (4) Aisha to confirm acceptance.
Aisha (CS): noted. I'll ping MarlinHealth with the interim plan and ask for permission to share usage sample.
pack-bot: deploy scheduled: none. :robot_face:
Luis (CSM): thanks team. can we add a small checkbox in the customer spreadsheet: "cost-sensitive expansion" so AMs flag faster?
Theo (PM): yes — add a column and include the action items. I'll add a short spec to the backlog after Riley's scoping.
Aisha (CS): MarlinHealth is happy with that plan for now, asked to be CC'd on the cost doc. I'll add them once Maya's notebook is ready. :thumbsup:
